description: Source code implementing a PackageManager class with plugin registration, package operations, notification handling, and interface management within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements plugin, package management, broker, and callback interfaces for package operations and notifications within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling notifications for dangling pointers and revocations, implementing INotification interface.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, registers notification callback.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters notification callback and releases service reference.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns JSON string with service identifier.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Calls underlying package manager to install a package.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Calls underlying package manager to uninstall a package.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Calls underlying package manager to download a package.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a package via underlying package manager.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage details of a package.

methods.name: SetAuxMetadata
methods.description: Sets auxiliary metadata for a package.

methods.name: ClearAuxMetadata
methods.description: Clears auxiliary metadata for a package.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a package.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing package operation.

methods.name: GetProgress
methods.description: Gets progress of a package operation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification observer.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Retrieves list of installed packages.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a package.

methods.name: GetLockInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock information for a package.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers a package manager implementation.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a package manager implementation.

methods.name: OperationStatusUpdate
methods.description: Handles status updates for package operations.

methods.name: OperationStatusNotification
methods.description: Notifies observers of package operation status.

methods.name: PackageManager
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the current package manager.

methods.description: Handles dangling pointer cleanup for package manager.
